STATE OF NCT OF DELHI & ANR.
 
 Through:
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL

Counsel for petitioner states that by the impugned order, charges were framed against the petitioners which is husband, mother in-law, father in-law and sister in-law in FIR No. 152/2018 registered at PS: Model Town.

2. The charges in respect to 498A (against all), Section 313 (against the husband), Section 406 of IPC (against the mother in-law).
3. Counsel for complainant appears through VC.

4. A note of arguments of not more than three pages synopsizing the contentions of the partis along with list of citations that they wish to rely upon and the corresponding PDF page numbers of the Court file shall be exchanged between the parties at least one week before the next date of hearing and file before the Court.
5. The next date before the Trial Court is of 19th September, 2024.
